passages.text: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.
passages.sermon:
Jericho was a city.
The people of Jericho closed the city tightly.
They shut the city because of the Israelites.
No one left Jericho.
No one entered Jericho.
passages.original: וִֽירִיחוֹ֙ סֹגֶ֣רֶת וּמְסֻגֶּ֔רֶת מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ין יוֹצֵ֖א וְאֵ֥ין בָּֽא׃ס

passages.text: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand, along with its king and its mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “Look, I have given Jericho to you.
I have given you the king of Jericho.
I have given you the strong and brave soldiers of Jericho.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי בְיָֽדְךָ֔ אֶת־ יְרִיח֖וֹ וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּ֑הּ גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י הֶחָֽיִל׃

passages.text: March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God gave Joshua instructions.
Joshua led the Israelites.
The Israelites had many men of war.
God commanded all the men of war to march around Jericho.
They must march around the city one time each day.
They must do this for six days.
passages.original: וְסַבֹּתֶ֣ם אֶת־ הָעִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַקֵּ֥יף אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark. Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times, while the priests blow the horns.
passages.sermon:
Seven priests will carry seven rams’ horns.
They will walk in front of the ark of the LORD.
On the seventh day, you will march around the city seven times.
The priests will blow the rams’ horns as you march.
passages.original: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹהֲנִ֡ים יִשְׂאוּ֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י תָּסֹ֥בּוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And when there is a long blast of the ram’s horn and you hear its sound, have all the people give a mighty shout. Then the wall of the city will collapse and all your people will charge straight into the city.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel.
The priests will blow a ram’s horn for a long time.
You will hear the sound of the horn.
All the people must shout loudly.
The wall of the city will fall down.
Each person will go straight ahead into the city.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ׀ בְּקֶ֣רֶן הַיּוֹבֵ֗ל בְּשָׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר יָרִ֥יעוּ כָל־ הָעָ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָעִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ וְעָל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said, “Take up the ark of the covenant and have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua called the priests.
Joshua spoke to the priests.
Joshua said, “Lift up the ark of the covenant.”
Joshua said, “Seven priests must carry seven rams’ horns.”
The seven priests must walk in front of the ark of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־ נוּן֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם שְׂא֖וּ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹֽהֲנִ֗ים יִשְׂאוּ֙ שִׁבְעָ֤ה שֽׁוֹפְרוֹת֙ יוֹבְלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And he told the people, “Advance and march around the city, with the armed troops going ahead of the ark of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the people.
He gave them instructions.
He said, "Go forward."
He said, "March around the city."
He said, "Let the armed troops go first."
He said, "The armed troops will go ahead of the ark."
The ark belonged to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם עִבְר֖וּ וְסֹ֣בּוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֑יר וְהֶ֣חָל֔וּץ יַעֲבֹ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: After Joshua had spoken to the people, seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the horns, and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the people.
Seven priests stood ready.
Each priest carried a ram’s horn.
The priests walked in front of the LORD.
The priests moved forward.
The priests blew the rams’ horns.
The ark of the covenant belonged to the LORD.
The ark followed behind the priests.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כֶּאֱמֹ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אֶל־ הָעָם֒ וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָבְר֕וּ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַֽאֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: While the horns continued to sound, the armed troops marched ahead of the priests who blew the horns, and the rear guard followed the ark.
passages.sermon:
The armed troops marched in front of the priests.
The priests blew the horns.
The rear guard followed behind the ark.
The horns kept sounding.
passages.original: וְהֶחָל֣וּץ הֹלֵ֔ךְ לִפְנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים תָּקְעוּ הַשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן הָל֖וֹךְ וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: But Joshua had commanded the people: “Do not give a battle cry or let your voice be heard; do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you are to shout!”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua gave a command to the people.
He said, “Do not shout.
Do not let your voice be heard.
Do not say a word.
Wait until the day I tell you to shout.
On that day, you must shout.”
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָעָם֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹ֤א תָרִ֙יעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־ תַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶת־ קוֹלְכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־ יֵצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֣וֹם אָמְרִ֧י אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הָרִ֖יעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶֽם׃

passages.text: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel.
The priests carried the ark of the LORD.
They carried the ark around the city.
They circled the city one time.
After this, the people went back to their camp.
They stayed in the camp that night.
passages.original: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב אֲרוֹן־ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר הַקֵּ֖ף פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ

passages.text: Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests took the ark of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua got up early in the morning.
The priests served God.
The priests took the ark of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns kept marching ahead of the ark of the LORD and blowing the horns. The armed troops went in front of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the LORD, while the horns kept sounding.
passages.sermon:
Seven priests walked in front of the ark of the LORD.
Each priest carried a ram’s horn.
The priests marched forward.
The priests blew the horns as they walked.
Armed troops marched in front of the priests.
The rear guard marched behind the ark of the LORD.
The horns kept sounding as they marched.
passages.original: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֜וֹת הַיֹּבְלִ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הֹלְכִ֣ים הָל֔וֹךְ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הוֹלֵךְ וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the Israelites.
The Israelites marched around the city of Jericho.
On the second day, they marched around the city one time.
After marching, they returned to their camp.
They repeated this process for six days.
passages.original: וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֜יר בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשֵּׁנִי֙ פַּ֣עַם אַחַ֔ת וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times in the same manner. That was the only day they circled the city seven times.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed Joshua.
On the seventh day, they woke up at dawn.
They marched around the city.
They marched in the same way as before.
They circled the city seven times that day.
They did this only on the seventh day.
No other day did they march around the city seven times.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַיַּשְׁכִּ֙מוּ֙ כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔חַר וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֛יר כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים רַ֚ק בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא סָבְב֥וּ אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃

passages.text: After the seventh time around, the priests blew the horns, and Joshua commanded the people, “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!
passages.sermon:
The Israelites marched around the city of Jericho.
They did this seven times on the seventh day.
The priests led the people.
The priests blew their horns after the seventh time.
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua spoke to the people.
Joshua said, “Shout!”
Joshua said, “The LORD has given you the city.”
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ית תָּקְע֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל־ הָעָם֙ הָרִ֔יעוּ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: Now the city and everything in it must be devoted to the LORD for destruction. Only Rahab the prostitute and all those with her in her house will live, because she hid the spies we sent.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to destroy the city of Jericho.
They must devote the city and everything in it to the LORD.
No one and nothing in the city may be spared.
Only Rahab will live.
Rahab is a prostitute.
Everyone with Rahab in her house will also live.
Rahab hid the spies whom the Israelites sent.
Because Rahab protected the spies, she and her household will be spared.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֨ה הָעִ֥יר חֵ֛רֶם הִ֥יא וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖הּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה רַק֩ רָחָ֨ב הַזּוֹנָ֜ה תִּֽחְיֶ֗ה הִ֚יא וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֣הּ בַּבַּ֔יִת כִּ֣י הֶחְבְּאַ֔תָה אֶת־ הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: But keep away from the things devoted to destruction, lest you yourself be set apart for destruction. If you take any of these, you will set apart the camp of Israel for destruction and bring disaster upon it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the people of Israel.
He told them to keep away from the things devoted to destruction.
Do not take anything that is set apart for destruction.
If you take from these things, you will bring destruction on yourselves.
You will also bring destruction on the whole camp of Israel.
You will cause disaster for everyone.
passages.original: וְרַק־ אַתֶּם֙ שִׁמְר֣וּ מִן־ הַחֵ֔רֶם פֶּֽן־ תַּחֲרִ֖ימוּ וּלְקַחְתֶּ֣ם מִן־ הַחֵ֑רֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֵ֔רֶם וַעֲכַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For all the silver and gold and all the articles of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD; they must go into His treasury.”
passages.sermon:
The silver belongs to the LORD.
The gold belongs to the LORD.
All the articles made of bronze belong to the LORD.
All the articles made of iron belong to the LORD.
These things are holy to the LORD.
You must put them into the LORD’s treasury.
passages.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב וּכְלֵ֤י נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וּבַרְזֶ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה אוֹצַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה יָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: So when the rams’ horns sounded, the people shouted. When they heard the blast of the horn, the people gave a great shout, and the wall collapsed. Then all the people charged straight into the city and captured it.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel stood before the city of Jericho.
They listened for the sound of the rams’ horns.
The priests blew the rams’ horns.
The people heard the sound of the horn.
The people shouted loudly.
The people gave a great shout.
The wall of Jericho collapsed and fell down flat.
Each person went straight ahead into the city.
The people of Israel entered the city.
The people captured the city.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣רַע הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּתְקְע֖וּ בַּשֹּֽׁפָר֑וֹת וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ הָעָ֜ם אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֗ר וַיָּרִ֤יעוּ הָעָם֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַתִּפֹּ֨ל הַֽחוֹמָ֜ה תַּחְתֶּ֗יהָ וַיַּ֨עַל הָעָ֤ם הָעִ֙ירָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ נֶגְדּ֔וֹ וַֽיִּלְכְּד֖וּ אֶת־ הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: At the edge of the sword they devoted to destruction everything in the city—man and woman, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites entered the city.
They destroyed everything in the city.
They killed every man.
They killed every woman.
They killed every young person.
They killed every old person.
They killed every ox.
They killed every sheep.
They killed every donkey.
They killed all these with the sword.
passages.original: וַֽיַּחֲרִ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר מֵאִישׁ֙ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֔ה מִנַּ֖עַר וְעַד־ זָקֵ֑ן וְעַ֨ד שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֛ה וַחֲמ֖וֹר לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Meanwhile, Joshua told the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the house of the prostitute and bring out the woman and all who are with her, just as you promised her.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the two men who had spied out the land.
Joshua said to them, "Go to the house of the prostitute."
"Bring out the woman from there."
"Bring out everyone who belongs to her."
"Do this just as you promised her."
passages.original: וְלִשְׁנַ֨יִם הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הַֽמְרַגְּלִ֤ים אֶת־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בֹּ֖אוּ בֵּית־ הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזּוֹנָ֑ה וְהוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִשָּׁ֤ם אֶת־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּ֖ם לָֽהּ׃

passages.text: So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers, and all who belonged to her. They brought out her whole family and settled them outside the camp of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Two young men had spied out the land for Israel.
These young spies entered the city.
They brought out Rahab.
They brought out Rahab’s father.
They brought out Rahab’s mother.
They brought out Rahab’s brothers.
They brought out everyone who belonged to Rahab.
They brought out all her family members.
They placed Rahab and her family outside the camp of Israel.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ הַנְּעָרִ֣ים הַֽמְרַגְּלִ֗ים וַיֹּצִ֡יאוּ אֶת־ רָ֠חָב וְאֶת־ אָבִ֨יהָ וְאֶת־ אִמָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־ אַחֶ֙יהָ֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָ֔הּ וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ הוֹצִ֑יאוּ וַיַּ֨נִּיח֔וּם מִח֖וּץ לְמַחֲנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then the Israelites burned up the city and everything in it. However, they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites burned the city.
They destroyed everything in the city with fire.
They did not keep anything for themselves.
They took the silver and the gold.
They took the bronze and the iron objects.
They put these valuable things into the treasury of the LORD’s house.
passages.original: וְהָעִ֛יר שָׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֑הּ רַ֣ק׀ הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֗ב וּכְלֵ֤י הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וְהַבַּרְזֶ֔ל נָתְנ֖וּ אוֹצַ֥ר בֵּית־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho. So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Rahab was a prostitute in Jericho.
Joshua spared Rahab.
He also spared her father’s household.
He spared everyone who belonged to her.
Rahab had hidden the men Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
Because of this, Joshua let Rahab and her family live.
Rahab has lived among the Israelites until today.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ רָחָ֣ב הַ֠זּוֹנָה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֨ית אָבִ֤יהָ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָהּ֙ הֶחֱיָ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י הֶחְבִּ֙יאָה֙ אֶת־ הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לְרַגֵּ֥ל אֶת־ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: At that time Joshua invoked this solemn oath: “Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho; at the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
At that time, Joshua made a solemn oath.
He spoke before all the people.
He said, “Cursed is the man before the LORD who rebuilds this city, Jericho.
If a man tries to lay its foundations, he will lose his firstborn son.
If he sets up its gates, he will lose his youngest son.”
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖יא לֵאמֹ֑ר אָר֨וּר הָאִ֜ישׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָקוּם֙ וּבָנָ֞ה אֶת־ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ אֶת־ יְרִיח֔וֹ בִּבְכֹר֣וֹ יְיַסְּדֶ֔נָּה וּבִצְעִיר֖וֹ יַצִּ֥יב דְּלָתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
passages.sermon: The LORD was with Joshua.\r\nJoshua became famous.\r\nPeople in all the land heard about Joshua.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיְהִ֥י שָׁמְע֖וֹ בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
